title: stream gapped
description: A client of GET /api/events missed events and reloads its state; every app that serves events sends it as <product>.stream.gapped. A client never shows a state with changes missing: it reloads instead (ADR-E3).

type.description: <product>.stream.gapped: one name for every app, only the product differs, so a client handles a gap the same way for every app (ADR-E2).

subject.description: Always stream: the gap is in the stream itself, not in one thing.

data.description: Where the gap is: the last event the client had and the oldest one the server still keeps.

lastKnown.description: The last event the server knows the client had; empty when the id is not one of this server's. With oldestKept it shows which events the client missed.

oldestKept.description: The oldest event the server still keeps; left out when it keeps none. A server keeps only so many events for Last-Event-ID, so a client further behind gets this event (ADR-E3).
